doc_version: Kubernetes docs (live; latest release v1.37.1 on 2026-10-11)
sensed_signal: resource utilization (CPU/mem default) OR custom/object/external metrics
coordination_hook: NONE for peers. Plumbing only: can consume any custom/external metric (so a reconstructed demand metric can be fed in; this is how the paper's P2 is wired). No awareness of shedders/ejection.
notes: Default downscale stabilization window 5 min (doc). Default signal is CPU, not request rate - contradicts paper Sec I scenario unless HPA is configured on a request-rate metric.

doc_version: kubernetes/autoscaler FAQ (master; NOT fetched/verified this session)
sensed_signal: unschedulable (pending) pods; node utilization for scale-down
notes: Cascades from HPA via pending pods (serial coupling by design).

sensed_signal: consecutive 5xx / gateway failures / local-origin failures; success-rate & failure-percentage stats
coordination_hook: PARTIAL (intra-pool guard): max_ejection_percent caps ejections; ejected hosts are re-used when the load balancer enters panic (panic threshold default 50%). This is a coarse cascade guard between ejection and LB, not peer coordination.
notes: Adaptive-concurrency 503s are 'gateway failures' (502/503/504) and can feed consecutive_gateway_failure ejection - an observation-coupling path between two Envoy mechanisms.

sensed_signal: in-flight counts: connections, pending requests, requests, retries

coordination_hook: NONE. Doc mentions jitter to reduce minRTT-window effect 'if retries are enabled' - acknowledges interaction, no hook.

notes: Global rate limit not separately audited.

coordination_hook: YES (intra-Envoy, narrow): retry budget is a CircuitBreakers threshold; retries are bounded as budget_percent (default 20%) of active+pending requests. A built-in allocation between retry and admission - a shared-signal bound, though not a severity budget.

YES (pool-health gate): minHealthPercent - outlier detection is disabled when healthy hosts fall below the threshold and the proxy balances across all hosts. maxEjectionPercent default 10%. Gates ejection on topology/health state, a crude form of the paper's P3.

sensed_signal: response status (5xx / gRPC codes) per route
coordination_hook: NONE in current annotation-based retries (retry.linkerd.io/limit, default 1). Legacy ServiceProfile retryBudget (retryRatio) bounds retries to a ratio of original requests - self-referential, not peer.
notes: Paper names 'Linkerd retry budget'; current docs favor per-request limit; budget lives in legacy ServiceProfiles.
